'''Glowwater Swamp''' was a toxic [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] located in the [[Markaran Plains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], between the clean waters of [[Stillwater Bend]] and the purified river that ran through the adjacent [[Stillwater Farms]]. The swamp was created by damaged pipes that fed chemicals to the nearby [[Okara Droid Factory]].
